decision: D5-1: no degraded mode. Full OSC runs only on a supply contract that meets the OSC table; otherwise no rail is enabled (accept or refuse). The usage-limit re-basing (D5-2) and switchable power domains (D5-3) are not adopted.

topic: G07 envelope gate, trigger and stage behavior
decision: Accept the captured behavior for all six envelopes: SIG and the button are ORed, so pressing the button while SIG is high does not retrigger. A combined rising edge starts rise from the current level. ASR falls when the combined gate falls; AR completes its cycle; LOOP restarts after EOC. STG indicates the selected rise or fall phase and is low during sustain/idle. A simultaneous new trigger takes priority over completion/EOC.
rationale: Owner selected Accept captured behavior (recommended) in the WSL implementation session; this settles the product behavior without changing the existing circuit.
status: behavior confirmed; circuit, timing and physical qualification remain open; no hardware or manufacturing adoption

topic: No-load start-up step: current-limit exception (PD20 Board B20)
decision: Replace the 2026-11-03 no-load slope exceptions (-12 V <= 1.47 V/ms, +5 V <= 0.95 V/ms) with a current limit. No load only: while |-12 V| <= 0.75 V the charging current is <= 350 mA into any bank up to 180 uF; while +5 V <= 0.45 V it is <= 180 mA into any bank up to 120 uF. No V/ms figure applies inside those regions. Conditions: (1) no load only; loaded starts keep 1.23 / 1.22 / 0.51 V/ms; (2) +12 V is on the common ramp during the step, and the start-skew and one-rail rows are not relaxed; (3) monotonic with no reversal; after the step the rail may lead the ideal common tracking ramp by at most 0.25 V and may hold flat while the ramp catches up, returning to the normal tracking difference within 15 ms of the ramp start; the band-entry skew row (all rails within 2 ms) still applies; (4) above the regions the base slope rows and every voltage-form skew row apply unchanged.
rationale: No retained OSC datasheet gives a supply dV/dt, ramp-rate or charge limit. Inside the regions every rail IC is below its recommended minimum supply; TMUX7412F is below UVLO and powered off (SCDS404B 9.1, 9.3.2.2, 9.3.2.3) and latch-up immune (9.3.2.6). The step excursion is bounded by the region, so the only effect is charging current: 350 / 180 mA are 18 % / 45 % of the 1900 / 400 mA transient minimums and below the 2000 / 500 mA maxima.
status: RECORDED as an interface-contract exception; PD figures are simulation only; B20 is not built; electrical acceptance and physical qualification remain open
source: Owner acceptance in the project thread, relayed by the project coordinator; zudo-pd D1 contract-route note 2026-11-14
scope: Changes only the no-load start-up slope wording of the OSC-PD interface. It changes no OSC schematic, PCB, BOM or part, waives no other contract row, and does not cover injection from patched signals while the rails are low (R-INJ, #59).
